name: הצבה בביטוי – הצבת שברים ב-(s² + 2t²)/(3 − st) (באנגלית)

functions.name: ig2
functions.body: if q=0 then abs(p) else ig2(q,mod(p,q))

questiontext:
Substitute \(s\) = \({{CT:0}}\) and \(t\) = \({{CT:1}}\) into the equation:

\[ \frac{s^2+2t^2}{3-st}. \]

Be sure to leave your answer as a fraction in its simplest form.

[[input:ans]]
[[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Substitute the values (in brackets), work out the numerator and the denominator as single fractions, then divide by multiplying by the reciprocal and simplify.
Step 1 — Substitute
Substituting \(s\) = \({{CT:0}}\) and \(t\) = \({{CT:1}}\) into the equation:

\[ \frac{s^2+2t^2}{3-st} = \frac{\left({{CT:0}}\right)^2+2\left({{CT:1}}\right)^2}{3-\left({{CT:0}}\right)\times\left({{CT:1}}\right)} = \frac{{{CT:2}}+{{CT:3}}}{3-{{CT:4}}} \]

Step 2 — The numerator
Common denominator \({{CT:5}}\):

\[ {{CT:2}}+{{CT:3}}=\frac{{{CT:6}}}{{{CT:5}}}+\frac{{{CT:7}}}{{{CT:5}}}=\frac{{{CT:8}}}{{{CT:5}}}[[if test="{{CT:21}}"]]={{CT:9}}[[/if]] \]

[[if test="{{CT:21}}"]](cancelling the common factor of the numerator and the denominator)[[/if]]
Step 3 — The denominator
Write \(3\) with the denominator \({{CT:10}}\):

\[ 3-{{CT:4}}=\frac{{{CT:11}}}{{{CT:10}}}-{{CT:4}}={{CT:12}} \]

Step 4 — Divide
Dividing by a fraction is multiplying by its reciprocal:

\[ \frac{{CT:9}}{{CT:12}} = \frac{{CT:13}}{{CT:14}}\times\frac{{CT:15}}{{CT:16}} = \frac{{{CT:17}}}{{{CT:18}}} \]

[[if test="{{CT:22}}"]]The greatest common divisor of \({{CT:17}}\) and \({{CT:18}}\) is \({{CT:19}}\); dividing both by it:[[else]]The greatest common divisor of \({{CT:17}}\) and \({{CT:18}}\) is \(1\), so the fraction is already in its simplest form:[[/if]]

\[ \frac{s^2+2t^2}{3-st}={{CT:20}} \]
